Dear Sir/Madam, 
 
Subject: Disclosure of Analyst/Investor Meets/Calls pursuant to SEBI (Listing Obligations and 
Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2015 
 
In furtherance to our letter dated September 23, 2026 and pursuant to Regulation 30 of the 
SEBI (Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2015, we hereby inform 
that, the officials of the Company participated in the various Investor/ Analyst meetings held 
today i.e., September 28, 2026 at Mumbai which commenced at 12:00 Noon and concluded at 
4:50 PM. 
The list of participants is annexed as Annexure- 1. 
 
The same is also being uploaded on the website of the Company at www.fedfina.com. 
 
Please note that no unpublished price sensitive information of the Company was shared in the 
aforesaid meetings. This is for your information and appropriate dissemination. 
 
Thanking you, 
Yours faithfully, 
For Fedbank Financial Services Limited
